{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the data types and check for sentinel values
print("Data types:")
print(df.dtypes)
print("\nSummary of customer_age:")
print(df['customer_age'].describe())
print("\nUnique values in customer_segment:")
print(df['customer_segment'].unique())

# Check for -1 in customer_age
print("\nCount of -1 in customer_age:")
print(df[df['customer_age'] == -1]['customer_age'].count())

# Check revenue: it's string, so check for thousands separators
print("\nSample of revenue:")
print(df['revenue'].head())

# Check for QA orders with 999999.99
print("\nCount of revenue == 999999.99:")
print(df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99'].shape[0])

# Check for refunded orders
print("\nStatus distribution:")
print(df['status'].value_counts())"}
